7-draggable-1.tsx.notes: Correct: 300x300 SizedBox > Stack(expand) with a filled bordered background and a Positioned 80x80 square clamped to 0..220, keeping a raw unclamped position so the square re-syncs with the finger after hitting an edge.

7-draggable-2.tsx.notes: Correct: the Stack is sized by its non-positioned 300x300 bordered View; calling begin from both onPanDown and onPanStart is redundant but harmless because both reset raw to the same clamped position.

7-draggable-3.tsx.notes: Works, with two small quirks: clamping the accumulated position means the square keeps an offset from the finger after being pushed against an edge, and onPanCancel also calls onDrop, so a plain tap without a drag reports a drop at the unchanged position.
